releases.displayName: Update on recent Unity security vulnerability!

items.text: Due to a recently disclosed security vulnerability found in some Unity-built games, we wanted to let you know that we’ve already taken care of it on our side.

There’s no indication that the issue was ever exploited or that anyone was affected, but fixes have already been released - and we applied them right away to ensure that CROSSBOW: Bloodnight are now fully patched and secure.

You don’t need to do anything on your side - just keep your game updated as usual. We’ll continue to monitor the situation and follow the latest security recommendations to keep everything running safe and sound.
Stay safe!
Hyperstrange out.

Players can now have multiple controllers connected to their PC and operate the game with any of them, without needing to restart the game
Fixed bug where players couldn't select the level with gamepad
Added button icons matching the controller (Xbox or PS)

releases.displayName: The Hunt Continues - new update and console release announcement

items.text: It has been a long time since major news about CROSSBOW: Bloodnight graced your eyes and ears. Some of you might even have thought that it is all over. Yet as you can see, it is far from it.

From today you will be able to hunt in a new arena and test your crossbow against a new type of foes - the Frenzied ones. We have also added some additional changes about which you can read in the changelog below.
New arena: Morbid Graveyard
Leaderboards are now divided into three: Morbid Graveyard (new map), Tarnished Square (original map), Tarnished Square (scores from the first map from before the update)
New type of enemies: Frenzied Restless Ones, Frenzied Feral Ones and Frenzied Troubled Ones
Enemy spawn system tweaks and randomization
For those of you who don’t have enough of CROSSBOW, we will be launching a console version of the game in 2023. Stay tuned for more information.

releases.displayName: POSTAL: Brain Damaged update, Blood West Chapter 2, Supplice release date, INCIS

items.text: It is that time of the year again. Boomercon is upon us! Or Realms Deep 2022, if you will. We've had six announcements this year, so let's jump into it without further ado. This serves just as a summary - more detailed posts will be popping up on appropriate game pages within a day or two. Let's go!

notes.title: INCISION - Early Acces launch + Special Offers!

items.text: Check out our nevest, explosive release! INCISION is a rare gem - a very retro-looking, unforgiving throwback shooter, that's so full of wonderfully-executed ideas, that it feels fresh and juicy. That is if you like your juice in the taste of rust, rot, and horror. The game launched on the day of Realms Deep main event - 16 September, and is already gaining a lot of praise from the players on Steam. If you like games such as DUSK, you can't afford to miss INCISION. And speaking of DUSK - DUSK owners get extra 15% off the price that's been already lowered by 15% in the release week. Similar discount applies for owners of Nightmare Reaper and Hedon, with even more bundles on the way! Get your tetanus shot, and plunge into the horror now!

notes.title: POSTAL: Brain Damaged - Horde Mode announcement

items.text: POSTAL: Brain Damaged has already gotten a small balancing update. Now, on September 19 it's getting another one. Much more substantial - it should help a lot with the balance between exploration and combat, thanks to the new ammo mechanics. Wait, that's not what you just saw in the video above? That's very perceptive! November 10 will mark the release of the Horde Mode in POSTAL: Brain Damaged, so you can spend even more time with the Brain Damaged Dude!

Your favorite eerie wild west stealth-shooter with a bit of a immersive sim aftertaste has exceeded our initial expectations as to the reception and popularity. In wake of such success the Blood West team has been expanded, and the project was granted an extended development schedule, to deliver more content than it was originally intended. The second out of 3 chapters in the story of the Revenant Gunslinger will hit Steam on Halloween, and you'll be getting a map that's 1.5 larger and tighter packed with events and NPCs then the first one.

According to some sources, Supplice is the best-looking game in the entire Hyperstrange catalog. Well, beauty takes time! We've hold off making the announcement of the release date, to make sure Mekworx team has enough time to work their magic. Now, we're happy to announce the date you've been dying to know: 30 march 2023!

notes.title: GHOSTWARE: Arena of the Dead - new game announcement

items.text: And that's that. We'll be happy to hear your thoughts on our Hyperstrange Discord, steam forums, and clay tablets. Thank you for being a part of the Hyperstrange crowd, and Stay Metal!
